principles: Shared infrastructure does not imply a shared lifecycle.
Every process has one clear entry job, process-specific states, human checkpoints, evidence and exit invariants.
AI may prepare, search, summarize or propose; it never silently changes a human decision.
Every write is auditable and every terminal decision remains reconstructable.
Cross-process changes create review-needed work instead of mutating another process decision.

procedures.label: Monitoraggio normativo e fonti
procedures.job: Acquisire materiale e sorvegliare periodicamente fonti/cambiamenti nel perimetro dichiarato.
procedures.exit: A source observation is verified/rejected and, when relevant, impact is assessed and downstream work is linked.
procedures.claimBoundary: Monitoring discovers and records observations; it does not determine legal applicability or completeness.

procedures.label: Incidenti e quasi incidenti
procedures.job: Preservare i fatti, distinguere incidente/quasi incidente, chiarire impatto e risposta, confermare una versione e chiudere con motivazione.
procedures.exit: A confirmed case is submitted/closed with reason and explicit downstream-work acknowledgement where applicable.
procedures.claimBoundary: Operational classification does not determine legal notification duties, liability or regulatory significance.

procedures.label: Inventario di sistemi e oggetti
procedures.job: Mantenere un working registry governato di asset, sistemi, servizi, dati, processi, policy, fornitori e controlli.
procedures.exit: An object is active with authoritative identity and current attestation, or terminally excluded/retired with reason.
procedures.claimBoundary: The registry does not prove completeness of the real environment or external master systems.

procedures.label: Standard e Controlli
procedures.job: Dichiarare standard e requisiti in perimetro, collegarli a obiettivi/controlli e mostrare coperture e sovrapposizioni senza inferire conformità.
procedures.exit: The declared universe has explicit scope decisions and every applicable node is mapped, gap, or unresolved without hidden equivalence claims.
procedures.claimBoundary: Coverage and crosswalks describe the declared universe and semantic relationships; they do not establish legal applicability, certification or control effectiveness.

procedures.label: Azioni correttive
procedures.job: Portare gap/rischi/finding da proposta a lavoro assegnato, completato e verificato.
procedures.exit: Closed requires a distinct human verification with evidence; cancelled requires a distinct reasoned decision.
procedures.claimBoundary: Operational completion is not verified closure and priority is not a legal conclusion.

procedures.label: Rischi di compliance
procedures.job: Registrare scenari, valutare rischio inerente/residuo, decidere trattamento e riesame.
procedures.exit: A governed scenario has a human rating, treatment and review cadence; mitigation closure triggers reassessment rather than auto-closing risk.
procedures.claimBoundary: Risk scores are management judgements, not objective probabilities, legal findings or regulatory classifications.

procedures.label: Questionari e verifiche
procedures.job: Preservare una richiesta, produrre un response set completo, approvarne una versione e collegare evidenze/limiti.
procedures.exit: Every current question has an explicit disposition and the approved response set is versioned and human-approved.
procedures.claimBoundary: Approval is an internal response-set decision and does not constitute certification or external assurance.
